ownerSelectedScope: More familiar food/drink words like the selected éclair, latte, ramen, wasabi, cheddar and Gouda, within existing 3–6-letter rules.
method: Exact-spelling deduplication against all content JSON and all VOCABULARY review JSON/text, including approved, rejected, skipped and unselected spellings. Individually inspected primary sources for spelling and proposed sense. Kept a small batch without padding to an arbitrary count.
limitations: All eight await individual owner review; no gameplay files or runtime policy were changed.
Source attestation supports spelling and sense, not everyday familiarity. No native-speaker or corpus-frequency review is claimed; uncommon entries may still be unsuitable for required use.
All earlier vocabulary and campaign rules remain. Prior approvals from batches 13–15 await integration.
No candidate boards, repetition benefits or additional campaign capacity have been validated.
